headline: Pakistan posted a current account surplus of $39 million in October 2026, against a deficit of $371 million in September, State Bank of Pakistan data released on Tuesday showed, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Shift from a $371 million deficit in September

caption:
Pakistan's current account swings to a $39 million surplus in October! 📊
According to Business Recorder, State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) data released on Tuesday shows a current account surplus of $39 million in October 2026, compared with a deficit of $371 million in September and a deficit of $307 million in October last year. For the first four months of FY27, the current account deficit stood at $850 million, down from $1,062 million in the same period last year.
